body.intent: The run journal records every outside intervention in a run (a session message from outside the run, a manual resume, retry or abandon, an approve of anything other than a step the workflow itself asks the owner to approve, a hand commit on the run's branch), and rhiza run status and rhiza daemon status count them, so runs finished with no intervention can be counted; approving a workflow's own signoff (or other owner) step is the workflow working as written, not an intervention, and is not counted
